title: kbgit.py publish refuses a leak-scan value the public home already holds in another file
goal: publish treats a leak-scan (kind, value) that the public tip holds in any file as already public, so no refusal: a backlog item that quotes the synthetic test ids of _tools/test_querylog.py and _tools/test_sync.py no longer blocks every publish; a value new to the public home still refuses; the public tip's values are scanned once per tip and cached under _cache/; test_value_public_elsewhere_passes and a still-refused new value in _tools/test_kbpublic.py; reported from a Windows clone whose publish --dry-run refused only such an item file
